years.label: Year 1
years.title: General Arts Qualifying
years.description: Indian thought and culture, the emergence of Buddhism, basic Buddhist teachings, Pali grammar and prescribed texts.

years.label: Year 2
years.title: BA Part I
years.description: Early and Mahayana Buddhist philosophy, South Asian culture, social institutions, Pali texts and commentarial literature.

years.label: Year 3
years.title: BA Part II
years.description: Buddhist social concepts, contemporary thought, East Asian culture, Buddhist art, canonical literature and analytical Pali study.
